app_info.subtitle: Control your own computers
app_info.description: ReMCP lets an authenticated user work with computers they have explicitly paired: files and directories, images and screenshots, binary transfer, archives, searches, terminal sessions, and processes. Every device has its own revocable credential and connects outbound, so nothing listens on the computer. Every tool carries explicit read-only, destructive, and open-world annotations that match its actual side effects. Reviewers can evaluate the surface against an isolated per-account sandbox device that never touches a real computer.

justifications.read_only_justification: Read only: it reads the account device list and relay connection state and returns the result without writing anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: no external service is contacted.
justifications.destructive_justification: Not destructive: returns a list; nothing is created, changed or removed.

justifications.read_only_justification: Read only: it sends a liveness request to one paired computer through the relay and returns the result without writing anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: contacts only the paired computer through the ReMCP relay.
justifications.destructive_justification: Not destructive: the device agent answers with its own facts; nothing is created, changed or removed.

justifications.read_only_justification: Read only: it reads the signed-in account record, its paired device count and this month of tool-call usage and returns the result without writing anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: reads the ReMCP account only, no machine is contacted.
justifications.destructive_justification: Not destructive: returns account facts; nothing is created, changed or removed.

justifications.read_only_justification: Not read only: it writes one short-lived pairing code for the signed-in account and returns the command that uses it, which changes state on the selected computer or in a running session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: no device is contacted; the code is stored in the ReMCP database and expires.
justifications.destructive_justification: Not destructive: creates a single-use pairing code; it changes no user data and the same code is returned while it is valid.

justifications.read_only_justification: Read only: it reads the signed-in account’s own recent tool-call metadata (tool, device name, outcome, duration) and returns the result without writing anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: reads the ReMCP database only; no machine is contacted.
justifications.destructive_justification: Not destructive: returns metadata; nothing is created, changed or removed.

justifications.read_only_justification: Read only: it reads the signed-in account’s own aggregated usage for the requested window and returns the result without writing anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: reads the ReMCP database only; no machine is contacted.
justifications.destructive_justification: Not destructive: returns counts and durations; nothing is created, changed or removed.

justifications.read_only_justification: Read only: it reads this deployment’s version, endpoints, runtime package, retention and limits, plus the paired machines’ versions and returns the result without writing anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: reads the ReMCP server configuration; no machine is contacted.
justifications.destructive_justification: Not destructive: returns configuration; nothing is created, changed or removed.

justifications.read_only_justification: Not read only: it renames one computer paired to the signed-in account, which changes state on the selected computer or in a running session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: writes the account’s own device record; no machine is contacted.
justifications.destructive_justification: Not destructive: changes a display name only: accepted keys are limited to device_name, and access roots, command guardrails and resource limits cannot be set through any tool.

justifications.read_only_justification: Read only: it reads a text file from the paired computer and returns the result without writing anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: reads a local file only and never fetches URLs.
justifications.destructive_justification: Not destructive: returns file content without writing anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Read only: it reads the files matching a glob from the paired computer and returns the result without writing anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: local glob walk only, no network access.
justifications.destructive_justification: Not destructive: returns file content without writing anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Read only: it reads the named text files from the paired computer and returns the result without writing anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: reads local files only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Not destructive: returns file content without writing anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Read only: it reads an image file from the paired computer and returns the result without writing anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: reads a local file only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Not destructive: returns the image bytes without modifying the file.

justifications.read_only_justification: Read only: it reads raw bytes from a file on the paired computer in base64 chunks and returns the result without writing anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: reads a local file only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Not destructive: returns bytes without writing anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Not read only: it writes raw bytes to a file on the paired computer, replacing or appending, which changes state on the selected computer or in a running session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: writes a local file, no external service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Destructive: replaces the file content byte for byte, or appends to it.

justifications.read_only_justification: Read only: it streams a file on the paired computer through a hash function and returns the result without writing anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: reads a local file only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Not destructive: computes a digest and leaves the file untouched.

justifications.read_only_justification: Read only: it lists a directory on the paired computer, with an optional glob and returns the result without writing anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: reads the local filesystem only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Not destructive: reads directory entries without changing them.

justifications.read_only_justification: Read only: it reads file metadata on the paired computer and returns the result without writing anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: reads local filesystem metadata only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Not destructive: metadata read only.

justifications.read_only_justification: Not read only: it creates or replaces a text file on the paired computer, which changes state on the selected computer or in a running session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: writes a local file, no external service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Destructive: replaces existing file content, or appends to it.

justifications.read_only_justification: Not read only: it creates or replaces several files in one call on the paired computer, which changes state on the selected computer or in a running session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: writes local files, no external service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Destructive: replaces the content of every file it is given.

justifications.read_only_justification: Not read only: it applies a unified diff to one or more files on the paired computer, which changes state on the selected computer or in a running session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: edits local files, no external service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Destructive: rewrites the matched regions of every file in the patch.

justifications.read_only_justification: Not read only: it changes the permission bits (and optionally the numeric owner) of a file or directory on the paired computer, which changes state on the selected computer or in a running session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: changes local filesystem permissions only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Destructive: can remove read or execute access from a path, recursively when asked, which can lock the account out of its own files.

justifications.read_only_justification: Not read only: it replaces an exact text block inside a file on the paired computer, which changes state on the selected computer or in a running session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: edits a local file, no external service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Destructive: changes existing file content in place.

justifications.read_only_justification: Not read only: it replaces a line range in a file on the paired computer, which changes state on the selected computer or in a running session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: edits a local file, no external service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Destructive: overwrites the requested lines of an existing file.

justifications.read_only_justification: Not read only: it rewrites every matching file under a path on the paired computer, which changes state on the selected computer or in a running session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: edits local files, no external service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Destructive: changes many files at once without a per-file confirmation step.

justifications.read_only_justification: Read only: it compares two text files on the paired computer and returns the result without writing anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: reads two local files only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Not destructive: computes a diff and returns it.

justifications.read_only_justification: Not read only: it moves a file or directory on the paired computer into the system trash, which changes state on the selected computer or in a running session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: moves a local path, no external service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Destructive: removes the path from its original location; the data is recoverable from the trash with move_file.

justifications.read_only_justification: Not read only: it creates directories on the paired computer, which changes state on the selected computer or in a running session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: creates local directories only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Not destructive: adds directories and never removes or overwrites anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Not read only: it moves or renames a path on the paired computer, which changes state on the selected computer or in a running session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: moves a local path, no external service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Destructive: removes the source path and replaces the destination when it already exists.

justifications.read_only_justification: Not read only: it copies one file on the paired computer, which changes state on the selected computer or in a running session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: copies a local file, no external service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Destructive: replaces the destination file when it already exists.

justifications.read_only_justification: Not read only: it copies files and whole directories on the paired computer in one call, which changes state on the selected computer or in a running session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: copies local paths, no external service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Destructive: replaces existing destinations when they are present.

justifications.read_only_justification: Not read only: it moves or renames several paths on the paired computer in one call, which changes state on the selected computer or in a running session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: moves local paths, no external service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Destructive: removes every source path and replaces existing destinations.

justifications.read_only_justification: Not read only: it deletes a file or directory on the paired computer, which changes state on the selected computer or in a running session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: deletes a local path, no external service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Destructive: permanently removes the path; a non-empty directory is removed with its contents.

justifications.read_only_justification: Not read only: it deletes many files and directories in one call on the paired computer, which changes state on the selected computer or in a running session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: deletes local paths, no external service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Destructive: permanently removes every listed path in one call.

justifications.read_only_justification: Not read only: it packs files and directories on the paired computer into a tar or zip archive, which changes state on the selected computer or in a running session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: reads and writes local paths, no external service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Destructive: replaces an archive that already exists at the destination path.

justifications.read_only_justification: Not read only: it extracts a tar or zip archive on the paired computer, which changes state on the selected computer or in a running session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: reads and writes local paths, no external service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Destructive: writes archive members over files that already exist in the destination directory.

justifications.read_only_justification: Not read only: it captures the screen of the paired computer, which changes state on the selected computer or in a running session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: uses a local screenshot utility, no network access.
justifications.destructive_justification: Not destructive: returns an image; it may leave a temporary PNG when keep is true.

justifications.read_only_justification: Not read only: it starts a filename or content search on the paired computer, which creates or ends an in-memory execution session even though no user file is modified.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: searches the local filesystem only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Not destructive: creates an in-memory search session; no file is changed.

justifications.read_only_justification: Read only: it reads more results from a running search session and returns the result without writing anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: reads from the local search session only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Not destructive: read only.

justifications.read_only_justification: Not read only: it stops a running search session on the paired computer, which creates or ends an in-memory execution session even though no user file is modified.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: stops a local in-memory session.
justifications.destructive_justification: Not destructive: ends the search session; collected results stay readable.

justifications.read_only_justification: Read only: it lists search sessions on the paired computer and returns the result without writing anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: reads local session state only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Not destructive: read only.

justifications.read_only_justification: Not read only: it starts a shell command on the paired computer and can change files, services and external systems, which changes state on the selected computer or in a running session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Open world: a command can reach the public internet, install packages or call external APIs.
justifications.destructive_justification: Destructive: executes arbitrary commands with the rights of the account that runs the agent.

justifications.read_only_justification: Read only: it reads buffered output from a session on the paired computer and returns the result without writing anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: reads local process output only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Not destructive: advances a read cursor; no state is changed.

justifications.read_only_justification: Not read only: it sends a line of input to a running session on the paired computer, which changes state on the selected computer or in a running session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Open world: the running program can reach external services.
justifications.destructive_justification: Destructive: the input can trigger irreversible work inside that process.

justifications.read_only_justification: Read only: it waits for a pattern in a session output on the paired computer and returns the result without writing anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: reads local process output only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Not destructive: read only; the session keeps running.

justifications.read_only_justification: Not read only: it stops a terminal session and its process group on the paired computer, which changes state on the selected computer or in a running session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: acts on the local process tree only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Destructive: kills the session; unsaved work in that process is lost.

justifications.read_only_justification: Read only: it lists terminal sessions on the paired computer and returns the result without writing anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: reads local session state only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Not destructive: read only.

justifications.read_only_justification: Read only: it reads host facts from the paired computer and returns the result without writing anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: reads local system information only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Not destructive: read only.

justifications.read_only_justification: Read only: it reads the process table of the paired computer and returns the result without writing anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: reads local process state only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Not destructive: read only; secret-looking arguments are masked.

justifications.read_only_justification: Not read only: it terminates an operating-system process on the paired computer, which changes state on the selected computer or in a running session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: signals a local process only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Destructive: ends the process; unsaved work in it is lost.

justifications.read_only_justification: Read only: it reads the ReMCP runtime configuration on the paired computer and returns the result without writing anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: reads local runtime state only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Not destructive: read only; this tool does not change configuration, while set_config_value handles only the runtime preferences it explicitly allows.

justifications.read_only_justification: Read only: it reads local counters from the ReMCP runtime on the paired computer and returns the result without writing anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: reads local counters only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Not destructive: read only.

justifications.read_only_justification: Not read only: it changes one preference inside the device runtime on the paired computer (telemetry opt-out, read and buffer line limits, result size), which changes state on the selected computer or in a running session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Not open world: writes that runtime’s own runtime.json; no external service is contacted.
justifications.destructive_justification: Not destructive: rewrites one key of the local runtime.json; access roots, blocked commands, the command guardrail, the shell and the write limit are refused.

test_cases.description: Fixture: use the dedicated reviewer OAuth account; no paired computer is required. List the account computers and verify the hosted review fixture is not exposed as a real device.
test_cases.user_prompt: List my ReMCP devices and tell me which ones are online.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a device list with user-facing machine identity and online state; an empty real-device list is valid. The fixed review-sandbox fixture is intentionally absent.

test_cases.description: Fixture: use the dedicated reviewer OAuth account and fixed device id review-sandbox. Its seeded workspace contains README.txt. Browse the sandbox workspace without changing it.
test_cases.user_prompt: Using ReMCP device id review-sandbox, list the files in /workspace.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the sandbox directory entries, including the seeded README fixture, without modifying the workspace.

test_cases.description: Fixture: use the dedicated reviewer OAuth account and fixed device id review-sandbox with the seeded README.txt fixture. Read and summarize the seeded text file.
test_cases.user_prompt: Using ReMCP device id review-sandbox, read /workspace/README.txt and summarize it.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the seeded review README as text so ChatGPT can summarize it; no real computer data is read.

test_cases.description: Fixture: use the dedicated reviewer OAuth account and fixed device id review-sandbox. Its screenshot action returns a labelled synthetic PNG. Exercise the image preview end to end.
test_cases.user_prompt: Using ReMCP device id review-sandbox, take a screenshot and show it.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the labelled synthetic Review Sandbox PNG as native image content and renders the image/screenshot preview component; no real screen is captured.

test_cases.description: Fixture: use the dedicated reviewer OAuth account and fixed device id review-sandbox with its writable sandbox workspace. Exercise the exact-content write case.
test_cases.user_prompt: Using ReMCP device id review-sandbox, create /workspace/review-note.txt containing exactly: ReMCP submission test.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates or replaces only the requested sandbox review note with the exact text and returns the write result. No real computer is modified.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke ReMCP for general weather information.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What will the weather be in Warsaw tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: ReMCP should not be invoked because the request does not involve a paired computer.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke ReMCP for standalone writing help.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Draft a polite email asking my landlord to repair a leaking faucet.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: ReMCP should not be invoked because no local computer action or data is needed.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke ReMCP for a conceptual technical explanation.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Explain OAuth PKCE in simple terms.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: ReMCP should not be invoked because the user only requested an explanation.
